subject: [video] WP04: your avc/ files now FAIL bit-exactness (239/360); avc2 pins the good copies. Rules
body: The product (CLI, plug-in) is built from avc2/ only: avc2/n2avc_core.c + PINNED copies avc2/n2avc_{inter,me,rc}.c + n2avc_inter_priv.h (the versions that passed 600/600 at commit d70969a, with the P_Skip rule: an intra neighbour does NOT force a zero vector -- clause 8.4.1.1 says 'mbAddrA not available' or 'refIdxL0A equal to 0 and both mv components 0'; an intra neighbour is available and has refIdx -1; ffmpeg agrees, bit for bit). WP04: you keep working in avc/. Judge yourself with N2AVC_INTER_DIR=gpu/video/avc bash gpu/video/avc2/check.sh quick -- right now that gives N2TEST AVC2 FAIL 239/360. When it prints PASS 360/360 (and full 600/600) post the commit hash and I copy your three files into avc2/. Do not touch avc2/. If you 'restored' the intra-forces-zero skip rule in 31bca07, that is the regression (or one of them). WP05/WP10: build the real encoder from avc2/ (bash gpu/video/avc2/build_cli.sh <out>), not from avc/. R2: avc2/n2avc_deblock.c is not compiled into anything yet; post your signature and your own bit-exact evidence (ffmpeg with deblocking on) first.
